title: Labcorp Awarded Defense Health Agency Contract
summary: BURLINGTON, N.C., Aug. 27, 2026 — Labcorp (NYSE: LH), a global leader in innovative and comprehensive laboratory services, today announced an agreement with the Defense Health Agency (DHA) to continue serving as the primary commercial clinical reference laboratory provider for the Military Health System.
body_markdown:
*10-year agreement reinforces Labcorp's role as primary diagnostics partner for the Military Health System*


**BURLINGTON, N.C., Aug. 27, 2026 —** Labcorp (NYSE: LH), a global leader in innovative and comprehensive laboratory services, today announced an agreement with the Defense Health Agency (DHA) to continue serving as the primary commercial clinical reference laboratory provider for the Military Health System. The 10-year agreement extends Labcorp's longstanding relationship with the U.S. military and supports diagnostic testing for service members, retirees and their families.


The agreement includes a five-year base period and a five-year option period, enabling high-quality diagnostic services at scale while supporting mission readiness and continuity of care. Under the agreement, Labcorp will continue to provide comprehensive reference laboratory testing services for military treatment facilities worldwide, helping providers make informed clinical decisions for their patients.


“For more than a decade, Labcorp has been honored to support the health of America’s military community,” said Bryan Vaughn, executive vice president and president of diagnostics at Labcorp. “We are proud to continue our longstanding relationship with the Military Health System and remain committed to providing military beneficiaries with clear, reliable answers that help them make informed decisions about their health.”


Labcorp’s secure information technology infrastructure enables the rapid, compliant and seamless exchange of diagnostic information between military treatment facilities and Labcorp’s laboratory network, helping connect healthcare providers to critical laboratory insights while maintaining rigorous standards for cybersecurity and data privacy.


**About Labcorp**
Labcorp (NYSE: LH) is a global leader of innovative and comprehensive laboratory services that helps doctors, hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, researchers and patients make clear and confident decisions. We provide insights and advance science to improve health and improve lives through our unparalleled diagnostics and drug development laboratory capabilities. The company's nearly 70,000 employees serve clients in approximately 100 countries, provided support for 75% of the new drugs and therapeutic products approved in 2024 by the FDA, and perform more than 700 million tests annually for patients around the world. Learn more about us at[www.labcorp.com](http://www.labcorp.com/) .
